pageCache.text:
Welcome toClewer Green C of E First School
Welcome to Clewer Green.
Keep up-to-date with ourLATEST NEWS
It was lovely to award the children in our first Celebration Assembly of the term this afternoon with their Value Certificates.
Yesterday we all enjoyed a fantastic day of learning when Berkshire Birds of Prey visited us to help celebrate the relaunch of our refreshed Religious Education curriculum. The children had the chance to get up close to a range of amazing birds, asking lots of questions and showing real curiosity and enthusiasm. The visit linked perfectly with our updated Jigsaw RE scheme, which encourages children to ask big questions, learn about different faiths and beliefs, and develop respect and understanding. Children wrote their questions for the wise owl in a special notebook, helping to keep their curiosity and love of learning going every day. Thank you to Mrs Hawkes for organising the visit
In our final assembly this morning, our Worship Leaders were presented with a gift from Reverend Rosie. The children have done a wonderful job this year of delivering a weekly assembly, supported and guided brilliantly by Mrs Hawkes. Thank you to the Worship Leaders, Mrs Hawkes and Reverend Rosie for leading our school through such reflective acts of worship.

DT project: The Year 3 Boat Building Competition - July 2025
The famous Year 3 boat competition took place this week on a sunny afternoon on the field (in a paddling pool!). Each pair of children had planned and built their boat from a range of materials and the design criteria was as follows:
To stand a chance of winning, the boat also needed to withstand "storms" provided by Mrs Lee.
Round 1 and everyone got to test their boats for the first time.
Boats that sank or let in a lot of water were eliminated then we had Round 2...
...and the semi-finals.
In the final, the Tudors boat narrowly beat the Stuarts boat after surviving a few storms on the way. Congratulations to our finalists!

pageCache.pageTitle: Different types of transport - 15 May 2021 | Clewer Green CofE First School
pageCache.text:
Different types of transport - 15 May 2021
This term Foundation Stage children have been looking at different kinds of transport. We started off looking at ways to move on the ground and also looked at and made some maps. We then considered the emergency services and learned about their importance and what they do to help us. The children learned that important number 999 to call should there ever be an emergency. They also had the challenge to make sure they knew their home address. We then moved on to consider vehicles that move on and under the water and the children were very creative with junk and collage. To finish the topic we shall be considering things that move up in the air and indeed into space.
Have a look at some of the photographs of what they have all been up to!

Governors
The Local Governing Board
We have a Local Governing Board that comprises of 9 people and they each fulfill a different role as Governors. As a church school some of the Governors represent the Diocese of Oxford, some represent the Staff, Parents and some are appointed to represent the Harcourt Trust which has supported the school since it’s creation over 200 years ago by the Countess Harcourt. Staff and Parent Governors are elected members of the Governing Board.
In essence the Governing Board has a wide-ranging remit but its main functions are:-
Rebecca Cutter Clewer Green CE First School Hatch Lane Windsor SL4 3RL 01753 864544
If you would like to contact The Chair of Governors or any other Governor, please send an email via the Governance Professional – rjackson@clewergreen.org.uk
The whole governing board meets 6 times a year. In addition we have the following committees:
Pay Review Committee - meets twice a year. Pay Appeals Committee - is convened when necessary

Cookies
Some cookies are necessary in order to make this website function correctly. These are set by default and whilst you can block or delete them by changing your browser settings, some functionality such as being able to log in to the website will not work if you do this. The necessary cookies set on this website are as follows:
Website CMS
A 'sessionid' token is required for logging in to the website and a 'crfstoken' token is used to prevent cross site request forgery. An 'alertDismissed' token is used to prevent certain alerts from re-appearing if they have been dismissed. An 'awsUploads' object is used to facilitate file uploads.
Matomo
We use Matomo cookies to improve the website performance by capturing information such as browser and device types. The data from this cookie is anonymised.
reCaptcha
Cookies are used to help distinguish between humans and bots on contact forms on this website.
Cookie notice
A cookie is used to store your cookie preferences for this website.
